entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back immediately.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can definitely look into the return options for you. To get started, can I have your name and order number, please?
The name is Mike Schmidt. Order number is... VF77-B4-901. Don't waste my time, just process the return.

Thank you, Mike. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. I understand you want to return it. To make sure I'm helping correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It doesn't matter! I don't like it. It's uncomfortable. I want to return it. Are you going to do it or do I need to speak to your manager?

I understand completely. Let me check the return eligibility for you. Since this is a wearable device, our **policy** can be strict. After a certain amount of time, it's often considered **too late** for a return due to **hygiene** and product **sanitation** reasons.

Don't give me that 'hygiene' garbage! Your website says returns are allowed. I'm looking at it right now! If you don't refund me, I'll post this entire conversation online and file a chargeback. You'll lose either way.

I understand your frustration, sir. Please allow me just a moment to review the specific terms for your item... Okay. I've confirmed it. My apologies, you are absolutely correct. Your VeloBand Cadence Sensor is still unfortunately outside the 10-day return window.
See? I told you. So get it done.

Of course. I am processing the return authorization for you right now. I've just sent an email to the address on file with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions. Simply pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see a full refund within 5-7 business days.
Fine. About time. I'll check my email for the label.
Excellent. Was there anything else I could assist you with today, Mike?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
